dwelling number.description: Dwelling/household number on the census schedule; null for uninhabited entries

census place.description: Named location within the census sub-district

place.description: Reserved for future finer-grained location detail; always null in current data

surname.description: May be empty where illegible or not transcribed

forename.description: May be empty where illegible or not transcribed

relation to head.description: Relation to head of household (free text, e.g. 'head', 'wife', 'son')

age.description: Age at census; may be blank, '?' (illegible), a whole number, or 'months/years' for infants e.g. '6/12'

born.description: Place of birth; may be empty
